nom: TULA Brightening Treatment Drops Triple Vitamin C Serum

avis.texte: I used to use this for a long time and stopped. My skin hasn't looked as good since so I had to restart it. Within a week my skin already looks and feels better

avis.titre: Seriously the BEST Vitamin C ever
avis.texte: I was pleasantly, pleasantly, surprised with this serum. I had been using Tula moisturizer and really loved it, so when i saw this on a special sale i figured i would give it a try. Wow!! So glad I did. Its amazing. So light but in just the perfect way. Absorbs beautifully! No sticky feeling whatsoever. Has helped bring back radiance to my skin after healing from some health stuff. Brightens nicely. A little goes a long way. Note: The reason I gave it a 4 instead of a 5 is because its very pricey for a small bottle. I do try to stock up though when they have it on special. I never want to be without it. Its a definite must have.

avis.titre: Love this! A HG for me
avis.texte: I am 48 and have oily, sensitive, sun damaged, dark skin. I love this serum! Im on my 3rd bottle. I use it once daily after i wash my face at night and it just feels so good and makes my skin so soft. When i first started using it, other women complimented my skin which has never happened to me because Im usually so oily, which leads to breakouts. It doesnt have a smell which I prefer for my products to be fragrance free. I also like that 2 drops cover my whole face and neck so the 1 oz bottle lasts a good while. I do try to buy it when it is 1/2 off since its pricey. I tried a cheaper Vitamin C serum and it made my skin yellow (yikes) so I'm sticking with what I know works.

avis.titre: yes I would recommend ths product
avis.texte: I like this product the only thing I don't like about it's too high price

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm in love with this product the texture makes my skin feel so smooth the packaging helps the application process. it has no scent the skin absorbs it which makes it effective.

I don't have sensitive skin and pretty much tolerate everything, however, this one and the 24/7 moisturizer, just like I saw on other reviews, I feel like my skin is burning. Eventually it started peeling and I also got whiteheads (which I never does and I don't have acne-prone skin) on some areas so not for daily use nor for sensitive skin. So this is a no for me unfortunately.
This is my second bottle. My skin loves it. Gives moisture to my skin. Easy to use pump.

I rarely write reviews, but want to warn others to use with caution. All 3 times I have used this product, I have had a bad reaction, and my skin is usually fairly tolerant. The reaction was so bad, that I didn't realize it was for sure this product, thinking it must have been something I ate to have such an allergic reaction. A couple of days ago, I decided to try this product 1 more time, and used more sparingly since I suspected that it could be causing a reaction. I woke up with the worst reaction yet! My eyes were so red and swollen, I could hardly open them. My face was very red and warm, itchy, and my mouth was swollen. It took 2 days to start looking normal again. I still use the Tula moisturizer without issues, but will never attempt this serum again.
I love this product. It definitely makes my skin look brighter and has helped get rid of dark spots and skin unevenness. Definitely recommend this!
I've only used this product 2 times & had an allergic reaction! I woke up with swollen eyelids! Besides itching & hurting they were also red. I didn't read any warning not too…

I have dark purple spots on my cheeks from past acne and i kinda grabbed this product on a whim. I swear they look better after using this maybe three times. This is the only thing I'm doing different, so I'm thinking it is this product. I'm going to keep using it and see what happens.
Amazing ! This serum makes your skin feel soft yet it also tightens and gives a firm feel to skin. It gives a lovely, clean glow to your skin !!!! Love this

Excellent Vitamin C Serum. I love the push dropper. When I first used it, it did burn my face a little, but once you apply- it's refreshing. I did not experience any redness or irritation. I use it in the pm before bed, and top it will the vitamin c overnight cream. My face has never felt better.
I got this as a sample some time ago and knew I needed it in my life after the sample. Great product!!

I love all of my Tula products, been a user for about 4 years now. This one burns my skin and i can't seem to get passed that curve. I've tried once every two days, once a week, etc to work myself up to daily and every time i get burns on my face. :(

avis.titre: 24 hour difference on my age spot is incredible
avis.texte: In 24 hours my age spot is visibly lighter. I cant wait to see what the 8 week difference has in store for me.
hefty price tag for a serum that does nothing. i have seen no brightening, no dark spot reduction after finishing the bottle.
LOVE this product! It makes my skin look bright, smooth, and clear.

I heard this was a raved product so I purchased it hoping it would help reduce fine lines and dark spots. But I after 1 bottle, I haven't seen a difference. It does give a bit of a glow after initially applying. Still searching.
I wear this everyday under my male up . it's helped my skin so much
I think the probiotics have helped the complexion of my skin. I am not as oily as I use to be.
Wonderful product! So glad I added this to my skincare routine.

In addition to the cleanser and toner, this is my third go to product. This is the first natural, cruelty free brand I found effective. Always use this after showering or washing my face. Cleanser, toner, vitamin c, moisturizer.

avis.titre: Best serum for a great price!
avis.texte: Ok, folks, this stuff is AMAZING! I'm older and don't like wearing all that makeup anymore. I recently switched to Tula for face care, and my skin has never looked better! I use the serum during the day under my moisturizer - it really gives you a little extra glow and doesn't feel oily. Love it!

I like that this product is not sticky and does not have an odor. It has reduced the redness in my skin. I haven't noticed changes in my hyperpigmentation yet. I've been using the product daily for 2 weeks. I'll keep using it and see!
My skin regimen no longer feels complete without the triple vitamin c serum! I love it!
I love this serum - I feel like it has made a big difference with my hyperpigmentation ~!
I've been using this for over a month and I've really started to notice a difference in my dark spots and overall complexion. I'm excited to keep using it!!

This is a beautiful serum, but I recommend if you're oily and greasy, only use this at night. I use up to 3 drops at night and still wake up with a very strong glow. The dropper is very easy to use to get the right amount of drops out. Highly recommend to dry skin customers.
Been using for years, love how quickly it absorbs and how it works with other products I use
Have used the whole bottle before reviewing. I haven't seen any brightening to my skin. It absorbs well and doesnt clog pores but wouldn't repurchase.

This was okay for me, I've used the whole bottle but never noticed any changes. I have acne-prone skin so a huge pro was how this product has no pore-cloggers, didn't break me out, or sting. However, I don't think I'll buy it again due to price.

Im was really surprised at all the bad reviews. However i dont have sensitive skin and this product worked wonderful on my skin. I noticed a big difference a couple weeks of using consistently. It evened out my skin tone and brightened my face. I just finished the bottle so i will be repurchasing because of how well this product worked on my skin.
Love this new product, my daughter in law suggested that's what she uses and I see a difference in my skin already!

I purchased this product on Saturday afternoon - used it that night because the sales person recommended using it twice daily. I woke up Sun morning with my left eye partially closed. I figured I had cold in my eye. So, I applied it twice on Sun. By Mon, morning, my eyelid was swollen and my eye was red. I discontinued the product and now above my eye and below my eye is swollen. My eye is continuously watering. I purchased the product in Warrenton,Va but I live in Fredericksburg,Va. I called my local store and asked for a refund and she told me that it would not be a problem. I told her the brand name and she told me that brand " is a hit or miss" - they did not tell me that when they took my money. If this does not clear up by Sat - I will have to go to an opthalomologist. I will never put anything else on my face again if it is not prescribed by a dermatologist. To be honest , this needs to be taken off the market.

SO badly wish I had read some of these reviews before I tried a sample of this! I haven't reacted to any other Tula I used previously. One use was all it took. My whole face broke out into itchy lil blisters. It will take weeks to repair my skin. Beware delicate skin girlies!

Yall I NEVER write reviews, but I had to for this product. My hope is that it will save someone the agony. Firstly, I have NEVER had a reaction to a skincare product.. ever! I tried this for the first time along with a new cleanser (Neutrogena HydraBoost) and Tula's brightening eye balm. I had a terrible reaction (swollen eyes, face itching, and burning, flaky skin). My dermatologist ordered me to stop the use of all products, take a steroid for a week to clear up my skin, and then intoduce my products back one by one to see where the problem occurred . This product was the FIRST product I reintroduced and IMMEDIATELY I had another reaction. My eyes are SWOLLEN, my skin red, itchy, and irritated. Please avoid this product!!!!!!!!!!

56 yr old skin that needed some brightness to my dull complexion. I use it in the morning before I put on my moisturizer, primer, and foundation. It works well under makeup and seems to brighten my skin. Would recommend.

I have insanely sensitive skin now in my 40's, I am always nervous trying new skin care. However this brand and this product have become a staple for me. Been using consistently for almost a year now and I rarely, if ever need foundation anymore. I am very happy!

Seems like a fine product but it oxidized very quickly probably due to the type of bottle and dropper. I probably won't buy again. Too expensive to oxidize so quickly. But as a vitamin C serum, it worked fine while it lasted.

avis.titre: Burned my face and neck off
avis.texte: This stuff is super strong and definitely not for sensitive or dry skin. Used it once along with the tula moisturizer- instant all over burn- I had to slather my face and neck with Dermalogica Ultra Repair every two hours for days. Beware- ultra strong.
I have been using this product for a year now and it has lessened my redness on my face.
Love this - it's the third bottle I've ordered. They really last a long time and I've noticed a difference in a more even tone and skin texture on my face.

avis.titre: That is what I ordered an
avis.texte: That is what I ordered and got a box full of face cleaners not great
Use it everyday in between washing and moisturizer. I can tell the difference if I don't use this.
I started using triple vitamin c serum a year ago and I haven't looked back! It's such a good quality product that has made a world of a difference for my skin.
I use this day and night in my skin care regimen. It feels so good on my face and neck. My skin has felt very good since using this product. I plan on buying this again.
Dont waste your money, i have not even bad acne before using this. And now im breaking out crazy! I really wanted to like this product, so upsetting :(

I will preface this review and say I tried this product about 2 years ago and really liked it. My skin has since changed and become a lot more sensitive to harsh ingredients. Tula's ingredients are natural, but very harsh. If you have sensitive skin, avoid the entire brand, even their sensitive line! I purchased this product during the 21 days of beauty event knowing I had previously liked it. The first day I used it my skin got dry and itchy within a few hours. Halfway thru the day I was red and puffy. By the end of the day my skin was red, puffy, textured and hot. This was the worst allergic reaction I have ever had with a beauty product.

avis.titre: It was great, until it wasn't.
avis.texte: This product was really amazing until it wasn't. After a few months of use, this caused major burning on my face, redness, swelling, and huge breakouts. If you have sensitive skin, please do not risk it.
Worse vit c ever, I woke up the next day after applying once the night before and could not open my eyes. I dont have sensitive skin yet broke out and my eyelids were swollen shut. Returning item

I tried this and wanted to like it. used a whole bottle. if anything my age spots have worsened. didn't irritate my skin, but did nothing for it either. I found other c serums I have tried far superior.
Trash product, especially for those with sensitive skin. Burns skin and causes breakouts.
Theres other vitamin c serums that work just as good but cost way less.
This really helps dullness of my face, would recommend highly
This product is amazing. Makes my skin glow. Easy to use and I will definitely buy it again.
LOVE THIS PRODUCT, I have been using for a few months, and I really notice a difference! Everyone tells me how beautiful my skin is! Would highly recommend!

I had some problems getting this product at my local store, so ran out for a week or more. I noticed the difference in my skin in less than a week. This product evens out the color of my skin, which I love. I use it every evening. I finally ordered direct from the company and in less than a few days was back in business. I've used this product for over almost 2 years.

I didnt even put it on my eyelids but I broke out in a dry, flaky, swollen rash on my eyelids, around my lips, and in patches on my forehead that look like eczema or psoriasis. I dont easily break out in rashes. This stuff sucks.

Was excited to try as I love skincare and as I'm getting older beautiful clear glowing skin is very important to me but this product gave me a red itchy allergic reaction and made my face swell up. Took me over 2 weeks to get my skin back. I will stay away from this brand

Love this product! It isn't sticky! I haven't noticed any dark spots fading but i didn't start it for that. I wanted a product that would help keep my skin hydrated from a cellular level and help with dullness! I definitely feel like it helps the overall appearance of my skin

I love the Triple Vitamin C Serum. It goes on smoothly and is absorbed quickly. It doesn't sit on top of my skin so i know it's working. I've noticed a new glow to my face. Definitely would recommend.
I absolutely love this!! I can see a glow in my skin after using this

This is the first (of my many) Tula products that I'm having to re-order because I just use it so much I ran out! It make my skin noticeably GLOW (but not shine or shimmer), makes my skin feel soft, and does NOT break me out. I use it once or twice a day. It is the best product ever!
I'm almost 40, my skin had spot and old acne scars but I switched this serum and use only this and my skin looks so much better! Also doesn't break me out which is a huge plus!
Received Tula travel pack as a gift and immediately fell in love with the product! Leaves my skin hydrated and glowing all day. I'm very impressed with this brand :)

Even though I have just started using the Triple Vitamin C Serum, I can already tell a difference in my skin! My skin, especially on my forehead where lines and dryness are a problem, is brighter and smoother. My skin feels and looks so much better!

This is my second time purchasing. I like that my skin feels hydrated after using it and my sunspot appears slightly lighter. Only 4 stars due to the price, I wish Tula hadn't raised the price point on this.
Start my day off right with a nice fresh glow and energized feeling

I've been struggling with full dry skin for a while now, and this serum has changed the game for me! I put it on usually three times a week and it leaves my skin feeling brighter and refreshed! It smells amazing and never leaves my skin feeling greasy. Highly recommend to add into your regular skin care routine! You can tell this product was made with a lot of thought and care!

avis.titre: DO NOT BUY - SEVERE ALLERGIC REACTION
avis.texte: I am Disgusted that Tula continues to sell this product. I used This product and had a severe allergic reaction (twice) since I unfortunately Did not realize it was this product right away. My eyes were almost swollen shut and when the swelling went down I was left with extremely itchy/sensitive red skin all around my eyes. There are nearly 100 of these similar reviews between this site and other Beaty sites. This product should be discontinued ASAP.

avis.titre: Caused a dry/red/flaky reaction on non sensitive skin
avis.texte: I am not typically one to bash products, but I have extremely normal skin - non-reactionary, non-sensitive, have used all types of products over the years. This serum caused a reaction I have never experienced - my skin became really dry and flaky and really tiny bumps developed under my eyes and around/below my lips. My eyelids specifically were bright red and flaky and I never put it on my eyelids. I asked around a bit after this reaction and numerous friends of mine said the same thing happened to them. I have used a handful of vitamin C serums (expensive & cheaper - CeraVe, Sunday Riley, Youth to the People, etc); I would not recommend this product as its not worth it to spend this much just to take a gamble with your skin.
I think that this product is so hydrating! It is perfect under makeup or just in the skin!

I got a free sample of this that lasted me about 3 weeks and I think it's really working so I ordered a full size bottle. I love that it doesn't leave my face sticky and absorbs really quickly. Also a little really goes a long way, I only need 2 drops for my whole face so the bottle will last a long time. I do think it is making my skin glow and helping to fade some older marks from past acne. The only reason I gave 4 stars is that I just haven't used it long enough to see full results.
I love this serum! I use it daily before my moisturizer and it's not sticky at all! So light weight. Love!!!
This serum is so great! I put it on first thing in the morning under my tinted sunscreen, and it makes my face feel so refreshed and bright.

avis.titre: Major skin reaction to this product
avis.texte: I've used another vitamin C serum for years and had no issues with it. I tried this one and my entire face swelled up and broke out in hives. I'm not sure what was in this to cause this reaction but unfortunately will not be using it anymore.
I love how my skin feels after using this serum. I feel like the vitamin c has truly helped heal my acne scars and has kept further breakouts away. My skin just feels healthier!
I've been using this for over a year now. Love how this makes my skin look younger and glowy! It helped my acne a lot as well!
I may be only 26 with two toddlers but this has effectively changed my skin balance and glow!

avis.titre: Hi, it's me, I'm the problem, it's Tula.
avis.texte: I received this in a subscription box and was really excited because people love Tula. First this is pricey for a 1oz bottle, and I would never pay for that. At almost half the price the dermae vitamin c is wayyyy better and you get 2 oz. Anyway, i used this three morning in a row and by the fourth morning i woke up to a red burning cheek and my forehead looked super textured. A few hours later those same areas were worse with bumps and they were itchy. Im on day 7 and it looks to be clearing up, but this is the only thing it couldve been. Reading other reviews confirmed my suspicion. Im 40 years old, pale skin, normal to dry skin, and usually dont have reactions to skincare.

I got this in a subscription box so gald I didnt pay for this. I'm annoyed that I could've picked a different item & picked this cuz I needed a new Victamin C serum. The texture is thick & tacky it doesn't spread well I use 3 pumps and feel it doesn't cover my face well. It also pills up while I'm finishing my routine adding my moisturizer it starts to pill up. For the price I can find so many others that are better & cost less. The whole Tula line just doesn't do it for me. My advice save your money don't buy this, there are so many other Vit. C products that are 100 time better. It didn't make me break out like other reviews I saw but that's another reason not to get this.
I have used it for a few years and I love it! It feels good on skin! I usually put it on after moisturizing! Good product, you will not be disappointed!!!
I noticed a good improvement with this product. It feels sticky initially but quicly absorbs into skin completely.
I could tell a difference within 1 week! My face looks so much better!

I am very unhappy with this product ! I have burn patches under my eye , on my lids , forehead is dry and itchy, my top lip is all chapped , my top eyelids and under my eye itch and burn and are swollen!! This happened to me two weeks ago after using this product, but I was not convinced it was the vitamin C from Tula I thought it may have been a sample of moisturizer I had used so I had to deal with swollen eyes with red patches for two weeks, using ointment on the burns and not putting any product on my face ! It created severe under eye creases /lines so I had no other choice but to wait until everything cleared up before using any moisturizers or lotions. Finally , two days ago my skin was looking better so I started using just the tula vitamin C serum before applying my makeup and sure enough the burning itching and red patches, started to happen again all on my eyelid, and under my eye! This is horrifying! What is in this product that is causing, irritation, burning, and eyelid and under eye swollen?? I am very disgusted not only that I have to walk around like this, but the price I paid for this product this should not be happening!
I've searched for a skin care routine for a long time! This product is the perfect addition!

I love this serum, I have definitely noticed a difference in my skin since I have been using it. My skin looks brighter and healthy and more youthful and I can not say enough good things about this serum.
This product does noticeably brighten my complexion but if I use it daily, my cheeks look a bit red and irritated. I do have really sensitive skin. If not, I'd use it daily!
